Its orbit-metric flag complex is (S^0)^{*q} = S^{q−1}. At r≥2 the Borel construction is BC_m; the triangle monodromy one in the base identifies the classifying map as onto on π1 and H1. The cyclic-group periodic resolution verifies all characteristic cases. Seven direct finite enumeration tests pass.

value.rationale: The targeted gap is explicit and structurally motivated by a recent theorem. The uniform counterexample rules out universal no-overcount in every degree ≥2 despite a free action on each Rips realization in the relevant scale. Its exact all-field persistence barcodes distinguish a genuine false positive from characteristic-dependent Borel classes after the cover becomes contractible, without needing a paper-sized classification beyond this precise obstruction.
